card.name: Linking words before other drug products
card.fires_on: Words just before a drug name or product term in drug-label text, such as 'with', 'of' or the end of a drug name like amphetamine or acetaminophen. Also a space before a number like 13-digit.

card.plain: It marks spots in drug labels where another drug name or product is about to be mentioned, as in combination with other drugs.
